description: Style from two short English samples

samples:
Dear hiring team,

I read your posting for a product lead with interest. Over the last four years I have built data products from the first prototype to paying customers. I like short feedback loops and clear priorities.

I would be glad to tell you more in a call.

Kind regards,
Alex

Hi Maria,

thanks for the quick reply. Tuesday works for me. I'll bring the numbers from the last quarter so we can look at them together.

Best,
Alex

output.formality: polite but not stiff; first names in emails, 'Dear hiring team' in letters
output.sentenceLength: short to medium sentences, one idea each
output.description: Alex writes short, plain sentences and gets to the point quickly. Claims are concrete rather than enthusiastic. Letters open with a direct reason for writing and close with a simple offer to talk.
